info.title: Timekeeping (v2)
info.description: API endpoints used to manage Timekeeping in WinTeam.

get.description: This function gets the timekeeping records based on the DateFrom and DateTo date.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). Date from when the user wants to filter the results.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). Date to when the user wants to filter the results.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: A datapoint you�d like to sort records by. Possible values are: "timekeepingId", "employeeNumber", "jobNumber", "workDate", "hours", "categoryDetailId", "rate", "workTicketNumber".

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the order should be ascending (true) or descending (false).

patch.summary: Partially updates a timekeeping hours record.
patch.description:
Updates only the fields provided. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
            Returns 400 if the record has been paid (PaidByCheckID is set) or if tenantId is missing.

requestBody.description: JSON Patch document (http://jsonpatch.com/). Use "replace" operations for fields to update.

204.description: Record updated successfully. No content returned.

400.description: Bad Request — missing tenantId header or record has been paid.
